title: I Tried Bikepacking with a 17-Foot Canoe and a Velduro Phantom
content:
I went bikepacking and canoepacking all in one with the Velduro Phantom e-gravel bike. Not everything went to plan.

Read the full article at I Tried Bikepacking with a 17-Foot Canoe and a Velduro Phantom on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
